spec_match.rationale: The shipped surface (window.subApps, partial interface Window, [SecureContext, IsolatedContext], RuntimeEnabled=SubApps) is read directly from Chromium's sub_apps.idl, which the page links; the legacy navigator surface is probed as the migration artifact it is.

interactive.rationale: Re-probe button re-reads both typeof cells and the secure-context gate value live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises live reads of both surfaces plus the explanation of tab-absence; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Verdict copy covers all three exposure states: shipped surface present, legacy-only (old experimental build), and both-absent (normal tab), with a migration-safe fallback snippet.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6260680824061952; page links sub_apps.idl and the v150 capability gate.

conformance.rationale: The suite's legacy-navigator-surface-retired and isolated-context-gate-consistency assertions encode this page's two probes as context-aware contracts that pass honestly in both tab and IWA contexts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: both cells read undefined with the correct both-absent verdict; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: subapps-migration-probe-ran asserts with both typeof readings.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald/rose cells on paper (AA); native button.

accessibility.rationale: Probe cells are labelled text pairs; status is role=status aria-live; gate list is a semantic list.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Probe grid collapses to one column under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm window.subApps exposure from an installed IWA on Chrome 152
openQuestions.detail: The shipped-surface-present branch of the verdict cannot be exercised in a tab. From an installed IWA, confirm the window cell reads object and the navigator cell stays undefined. Note: v153/sub-apps/conformance.json asserts navigator.subApps.* — flagged for a human as likely-wrong assertions (immutable, not edited).

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce probe outcomes via live regions with text, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status line is role=status aria-live; cells carry the literal typeof strings.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive probe grid small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column collapse below a min width; wrap long identifiers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grid collapses under 640px; code/anchors use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): both surface probes read undefined in a Chromium 141 tab with the correct spec-grounded explanation, console clean at both viewports. The in-IWA branch and the stale v153 conformance assertions (navigator.subApps) are recorded for follow-up — the latter needs a human because existing suites are immutable.
